product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Free-Standing Large Screen Floor Mount for Back-to-Back Portrait Displays Fits 43-90 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy Duty Free Standing Large Screen Floor Mount for Back to Back Portrait Displays, Fits 43"–90" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy Duty Free Standing Large Screen Floor Mount for Back to Back Portrait Displays is designed for dual-sided digital signage where visibility from both directions is required. Two portrait-oriented displays are mounted back to back on a single freestanding structure, eliminating the need for wall or column attachment. This mount is suited for indoor commercial environments including wayfinding installations, advertising displays, lobbies, malls, atriums, and transportation hubs.Dual back to back portrait display configuration for two-direction visibility from a single freestanding structureSupports large format displays from 43" to 90" per screen in portrait orientationVESA compatible mounting interface for broad display compatibilityTilt capability for optimized viewing angles (see technical drawing for specifications)Freestanding floor mount design requires no wall or column attachmentIdeal for wayfinding, advertising, lobbies, malls, atriums, and transportation hubsProfessional installation recommended; inspect mounting at minimum every 3 monthsDesigned for indoor commercial use only BACK TO BACK DUAL DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONEngineered to support two portrait-oriented displays mounted back to back on a single freestanding structure, delivering two-direction visibility for audiences approaching from either side without requiring separate mounting points. FREE STANDING FLOOR MOUNT DESIGNThe self-supporting base and vertical support structure require no wall or column attachment, providing placement flexibility throughout any indoor commercial space including lobbies, atriums, malls, and transportation hubs. PORTRAIT ONLY DISPLAY ORIENTATIONDesigned specifically for portrait-oriented display configurations, making it well suited for tall digital signage content including wayfinding directories, advertising columns, and full-height promotional displays. HEAVY DUTY COMMERCIAL CONSTRUCTIONBuilt to heavy duty commercial standards with a robust base, vertical support, and included mounting hardware.
